QIT M365 Baseline

The mandatory floor for every QIT-managed Microsoft 365 tenant. No premium licensing required. Forked from CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations v7.0.0 Level 1 and retuned for QIT client working patterns: Teams federation stays enabled, anonymous meeting join stays enabled with a lobby, and guest link expiry is 90 days rather than 30.

Every standard is in Report. Promote to Remediate only after reviewing alignment for the tenant. DisableSMS and DisableVoice stay in Report until passkey registration coverage is confirmed, and must reach Remediate before 1 February 2027.

Version 1, 13 September 2026.
